INSERT INTO sys_attendance_statistics (user_id, user_name, stat_month, actual_clock_days, normal_clock_days, late_days, early_leave_days, absent_days, should_clock_days, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES
(#{s.userId}, #{s.userName}, #{s.statMonth}, #{s.actualClockDays}, #{s.normalClockDays}, #{s.lateDays}, #{s.earlyLeaveDays}, #{s.absentDays}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE actual_clock_days = actual_clock_days + VALUES(actual_clock_days), normal_clock_days = normal_clock_days + VALUES(normal_clock_days), late_days = late_days + VALUES(late_days), early_leave_days = early_leave_days + VALUES(early_leave_days), absent_days = absent_days + VALUES(absent_days), update_time = NOW()
